fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestNextVersion over fixture logs covers each kind, the pre-v1 breaking-is-minor rule and no change since the tag
fields.statement: tools/release check computes the next version and its kind since the last v* tag: major from v1.0.0 on when a change is marked or detected breaking (before v1 a breaking change makes a minor), minor when a milestone finished, patch when only bug fixes landed, none otherwise

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestGates with a fake clock, a fake CI status and a fixture daemon-run history covers each gate passing and failing and the severe skip; the timer records daemon status (commit, started) so the first-run time is known
fields.statement: tools/release check reports each gate for the candidate commit with why it passes or fails: CI green on the commit; the root daemon first ran the commit at least 24h ago and no bug request was filed since; no change set serving the finished milestone in flight and no question blocking one; a patch is at most one per 24h unless a severe: fix is in it, which skips the soak and the batching but never CI

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestNotes compares notes from a fixture log with a golden file
fields.statement: tools/release check drafts the release notes from the change sets landed since the last tag, grouped by milestone, with bug fixes and breaking changes (and their reasons) called out
